name: gap-fade
title: Gap-down fade back toward the previous close
description: Long only. A stock that opens at least 0.75% under the previous close (but not more than 4%: big news gaps are left alone) and closes a 5-minute bar back above its opening price between 09:30 and 10:30 IST is bought for a move back toward the previous close. Stop a tick under the day's low, target the previous close, flat by the safe flat-by. trader-risk's 1.5 reward:risk minimum filters out the fades with too little room left.
notes: trials_tried 1: an earlier draft (a break of the 15-minute range high) never cleared the 1.5 reward:risk minimum on the test data, so the entry was changed once. Every variant counts against the deflated Sharpe.
